positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Technology intern at Target with the Plan and Build team. Developed various new endpoints for an API written in Java using the SpringBoot framework. Some serviced basic CRUD requests while others involved larger data processing tasks.  Also worked on various pages on the fronted written in Typescript using Angular and Ionic. 

Towards the end of my internship I researched using Docker, K8s, and Drone to implement a more stable CI/CD pipeline.
